description: Round 15 source checks: Genelec 1031A and 8020C (CTF linked documents, promoted); Yamaha NS-6490 US page (supported, not promoted, host not allowlisted). Other queued URLs were not opened this round and have no entry.

entries.document: Genelec 1031A Technical Specifications (system specifications, Genelec Contentful asset). Linked from https://www.genelec.com/previous-models/1031a as 'System Specifications 1031A'.
entries.evidence: Drivers: Bass 8" and Treble 1" metal dome + DCW (two drivers). Amplifier power per channel: Bass 120 W, Treble 120 W (integrated per-channel amplifiers, i.e. powered). Linked from genelec.com exact-model page (two-way active monitor system).

fieldResults.note: System spec sheet: Bass 8in + Treble 1in metal dome = 2 drivers.
System spec sheet lists per-channel amplifier power (bass 120 W, treble 120 W); Genelec exact-model page describes a two-way active monitor system.

entries.document: Genelec 8020C datasheet (Contentful asset). Linked from https://www.genelec.com/previous-models/8020c as 'Datasheet 8020C'.
entries.evidence: Text: 'very compact biamplified active monitor system'; 105 mm (4 in) bass cone driver and 19 mm (3/4 in) metal dome tweeter; bass and treble amplifiers 20 W each (amplifier unit with active crossover). Chunk 1 of 2 not opened; no field depends on it.

fieldResults.note: Datasheet: one 105 mm bass driver and one 19 mm treble driver.
Datasheet: 'biamplified active monitor system'; bass and treble amplifiers in the enclosure.

entries.document: Yamaha NS-6490 Specs page, United States site (manufacturer). US variant only; no Malaysia page was found.
entries.evidence: Driver: 8" cone woofer, 4" cone mid-range, 7/8" balanced dome tweeter (three drivers). Nominal impedance 8 ohms; sensitivity 90 dB/2.83 V/m; nominal input 70 W, maximum 140 W; 45 Hz - 23 kHz. US product only.

fieldResults.note: US manufacturer page lists three named drivers. Host usa.yamaha.com is not in source-host-allowlist.json, so no promotion until the host decision (owner decision 8) is made. Not a regional impedance answer.
